V. 50.
It is expedient, that one man ſhould die for the people—So GOD over-•uled his Tongue, for he ſpake not of himſelf, by his own Spirit only, but by the Spirit of Prophecy. And thus He gave unawares as clear a Teſtimony to the Prieſtly, as Pilate did to the Kingly Office 〈◊〉
Chriſt.
